name: Mint Bubblegum
desc: A soft, chewy candy featuring a blend of two distinct flavors. With a bit of practice, you can blow impressively massive bubbles! Just watch out — if you push it too far and the bubble pops, you'll end up with a face full of sticky goo!

customize.name: Recipe: Mint Bubblegum
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Mint Bubblegum.

customize.name: Delicious Mint Bubblegum
customize.desc: A soft, chewy candy. Its fresh flavor glides smoothly down your throat, bringing an instantly cool and refreshing sensation. Better still, with a gentle puff, you can blow a clear, glossy bubble. A perfect little treat for passing the time!

customize.name: Suspicious Mint Bubblegum
customize.desc: A soft, chewy candy. You brave the mint's powerful chill, puff up your cheeks, and with great effort finally blow a tiny bubble. Then, just before success is within reach, it leaks with a few sad little pffts, and the whole attempt is ruined...

customize.name: Lohen
customize.desc: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

customize.name: Boredom-Busting Bubblegum
customize.desc: Lohen's specialty. Seeing that you were bored, he handed you a few candies and grandly claimed they'd help pass the time. After only a few chews, he suddenly pulled out a mirror and flashed it in front of you, looking entirely too pleased with himself. Oh no — it was a setup all along! Your tongue was already dyed a bright blue-green... So by "help pass the time," he meant his own?

customize.desc: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

customize.name: Sugar
customize.desc: A seasoning derived from Sweet Flowers. Has the power to give both energy and happiness.
